input: llm_response_raw; step_id; agent_id; prompt_hash; model_metadata; party_id; turn_id nullable
hard_gate: Raw result is stored exactly; code does not edit semantic content.
on_fail: Abort step with infrastructure_error; no world state writes.

hard_gate: Must be valid JSON where JSON is required; required fields must exist; enum values must match.
on_fail: Send raw result + schema errors to repair agent.
notes: This is structural validation, not semantic invention.

hard_gate: Repair cannot add facts, change accepted meaning, or fill unknowns with confident invention.
on_fail: Escalate to step retry or human/debug review; no commit.
notes: Repair agent is not a new content generator.

hard_gate: No unresolved source is silently upgraded; source status is preserved; unverified external facts remain draft/needs_review.
on_fail: Return to original/structuring agent with missing source/status list.
notes: Prevents bibliography hallucination and status laundering.

input: structured_result; established_party_facts; relevant world_base records; project rules; hidden_state allowed
hard_gate: Must not contradict year, region, season, authority, routes, position, body, items, ownership, NPC knowledge, hidden layers or character knowledge.
on_fail: Return result to responsible content agent with explicit violations; code does not patch meaning.
notes: The auditor detects contradictions; repair is another LLM step, not procedural code.

hard_gate: Player-facing prose/UI/journal cannot reveal hidden motives, hidden objects, future dates, objective truth of rumors, technical IDs or raw JSON.
on_fail: Return to visible-context selector/prose writer; remove hidden content before prose, not after.

input: structured_result; target_table_map; party_database_schema; world_base FK snapshot
hard_gate: All writes have target tables, IDs, ownership/visibility/status fields, FK references and transaction order.
on_fail: Return to structuring agent with exact missing table/field/FK issue.
notes: No partial write of world state before commit gate.

writes_to: target party tables; party_llm_steps; party_validation_issues resolved
hard_gate: Commit only if schema/source/semantic/visibility/write-plan audits pass or allowed warnings are explicitly recorded.
on_fail: Rollback transaction; mark step failed; no player-facing state update.
notes: This is the only step that changes authoritative party state.

actor: code validator + optional LLM auditor for semantic summary
hard_gate: Committed state revision must match write plan; visible output references only committed visible state.
on_fail: Flag critical_state_mismatch; block next turn until repaired by explicit state repair procedure.
player_visible: only final clean scene after pass
notes: Protects against stale prose after failed write.
